## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: restructuring without behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore`: configuration, dependencies, CI
- [ ] `test`: tests

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green and the security scan reports no new findings
- [ ] I added tests, including hostile input where it applies (control characters in names, huge or changing files, symlinks)
- [ ] No secret value is printed, stored or logged; output stays safe to paste
- [ ] No telemetry or new network access was added
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic (fake keys carry `TestOnly`); no real configuration, chats or personal data
- [ ] I added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, or the change does not alter behavior
- [ ] Code, comments and docs are in English and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
